verdict.rationale: No item explicitly says Firstbase files for or obtains an EIN. The evidence only implies it: incorporation customers can open a bank account 'without an EIN*', which suggests an EIN still pending (firstbase-docs-16). Separately, non-Firstbase-incorporated users must supply their 'existing EIN' (firstbase-docs-21, firstbase-docs-25), which suggests Firstbase handles the EIN for companies it incorporates. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation that Firstbase files the IRS SS-4/EIN application, turnaround times and handling for non-SSN founders, and independent or hands-on confirmation of receiving an EIN through the platform.
